title: Inventory the simple workspace page (Nodo) in web/src
goal: The record lists what the current web/src page holds and which part each F-130 step reuses, keeps or retires, so the simple view and the full dashboard start from the same components
acceptance: F-130's record lists each part of the web/src page (nerv-app shell and Nodo sidebar, sign-in, status card, device pairing, doctor view, update prompt, push toggle, reminders and inbox, push to talk, battery cards (retired by F-101-T07, not migrated), surface renderer, roadmap cards) with its API calls and the step that reuses, keeps or retires it

It names which parts the simple view (F-130-T16) keeps: chat, pending approvals, health at a glance, push on/off, the link to the full dashboard; and which shared theme tokens both layouts read (docs/STYLE-GUIDE.md)
Records only; any gap found becomes a step or a B- record in the same PR
privacy: Neutral invented sorties, devices and names only; tokens and pairing codes never in tests or logs.
escalation: A part the owner may want dropped from the simple view goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-25 (owner decision: keep a simple view): about ten components in web/src to list against the steps. Not a measurement.
